name: 36877 · Smiths Sta, AL
findings: ZIP 36877 (Smiths Sta) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 5 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36877 (Smiths Sta) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
